card.name: Inside umeclidinium and similar names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the pieces "um", "ume" or "ium" that start or sit inside a longer word. It is strongest in "umeclidinium" (Ellipta inhaler label) and also fires in "umbilical", "Umfreville", "Umari" and "umami".
